pairs: Vir autem quidam erat in Cæsarea,
Now there was a certain man in Caesarea,
a centurion of the cohort which is called Italian,
ac timens Deum cum omni domo sua,
fearing God with all his house,
giving many alms to the people,
This man saw in a vision clearly,
at about the ninth hour of the day,
the Angel of God entering to him
et eleemosynæ tuæ ascenderunt in memoriam in conspectu Dei.
“Your prayers and your almsgiving have ascended as a memorial in the sight of God.
Et nunc mitte viros in Joppen,
send men to Joppa and summon a certain Simon,
hic hospitatur apud Simonem quemdam coriarium,
This man is a guest with a certain Simon, a tanner,
whose house is beside the sea.
hic dicet tibi quid te oporteat facere.
He will tell you what you must do.”
Et cum discessisset angelus qui loquebatur illi,
And when the Angel who was speaking to him had departed, he called,
out of those who were subject to him,
et militem metuentem Dominum ex his qui illi parebant.
two of his household servants and a soldier who feared the Lord.
And when he had explained everything to them,
iter illis facientibus, et appropinquantibus civitati,
while they were making the journey and approaching the city,
ascendit Petrus in superiora ut oraret circa horam sextam.
Peter ascended to the upper rooms, so that he might pray, at about the sixth hour.
he wanted to enjoy some food.
Then, as they were preparing it,
an ecstasy of mind fell over him.
as if a great linen sheet were let down,
quatuor initiis submitti de cælo in terram,
by its four corners, from heaven to earth,
on which were all four-footed beasts,
and the crawling things of the earth
and the flying things of the air.
Et facta est vox ad eum:
And a voice came to him:
For I have never eaten anything common or unclean.”
Et vox iterum secundo ad eum:
And the voice, again a second time to him:
Hoc autem factum est per ter:
Now this was done three times.
et statim receptum est vas in cælum.
And immediately the container was taken up to heaven.
Et dum intra se hæsitaret Petrus quidnam esset visio quam vidisset,
Now while Peter was still hesitant within himself as to what the vision,
ecce viri qui missi erant a Cornelio,
which he had seen, might mean, behold,
inquirentes domum Simonis astiterunt ad januam.
the men who had been sent from Cornelius stood at the gate, inquiring about Simon’s house.
And when they had called out,
si Simon qui cognominatur Petrus illic haberet hospitium.
they asked if Simon, who is surnamed Peter, was a guest in that place.
Then, as Peter was thinking about the vision,
et vade cum eis nihil dubitans:
and go with them, doubting nothing.
I am the one whom you seek.
What is the reason for which you have arrived?”
et testimonium habens ab universa gente Judæorum,
responsum accepit ab angelo sancto accersire te in domum suam,
who has good testimony from the entire nation of the Jews,
received a message from a holy Angel to summon you to his house and to listen to words from you.”
rising up, he set out with them.
et quidam ex fratribus ab Joppe comitati sunt eum.
And some of the brothers from Joppa accompanied him.
And on the next day, he entered Caesarea.
And truly, Cornelius was waiting for them,
convocatis cognatis suis et necessariis amicis.
having called together his family and closest friends.
Et factum est cum introisset Petrus,
And it happened that, when Peter had entered,
et procidens ad pedes ejus adoravit.
And falling before his feet, he reverenced.
Yet truly, Peter, lifting him up,
for I also am only a man.”
And speaking with him, he entered,
and he found many who had gathered together.
Vos scitis quomodo abominatum sit viro Judæo conjungi
“You know how abominable it would be for a Jewish man to be joined with,
sed mihi ostendit Deus neminem communem
But God has revealed to me to call no man common or unclean.
Propter quod sine dubitatione veni accersitus.
Because of this and without doubt, I came when summoned.
for what reason have you summoned me?”
A nudiusquarta die usque ad hanc horam,
“It is now the fourth day, to this very hour,
orans eram hora nona in domo mea,
since I was praying in my house at the ninth hour,
et ecce vir stetit ante me in veste candida,
and behold, a man stood before me in a white vestment,
et eleemosynæ tuæ commemoratæ sunt in conspectu Dei.
and your almsgiving has been remembered in the sight of God.
et accersi Simonem qui cognominatur Petrus:
send to Joppa and summon Simon, who is surnamed Peter.
hic hospitatur in domo Simonis coriarii juxta mare.
This man is a guest in the house of Simon, a tanner, near the sea.’
And so, I promptly sent for you.
And you have done well in coming here.
Nunc ergo omnes nos in conspectu tuo adsumus audire omnia quæcumque tibi præcepta sunt a Domino.
Therefore, all of us are now present in your sight to hear all the things that were taught to you by the Lord.”
In veritate comperi quia non est personarum acceptor Deus;
“I have concluded in truth that God is not a respecter of persons.
sed in omni gente qui timet eum,
and works justice is acceptable to him.
God sent the Word to the sons of Israel,
annuntians pacem per Jesum Christum (hic est omnium Dominus).
announcing the peace through Jesus Christ, for he is the Lord of all.
Vos scitis quod factum est verbum per universam Judæam:
You know that the Word has been made known throughout all Judea.
incipiens enim a Galilæa post baptismum quod prædicavit Joannes,
For beginning from Galilee, after the baptism which John preached,
quomodo unxit eum Deus Spiritu Sancto,
whom God anointed with the Holy Spirit
et sanando omnes oppressos a diabolo,
and healing all those oppressed by the devil.
Et nos testes sumus omnium quæ fecit in regione Judæorum,
And we are witnesses of all that he did in the region of Judea
he whom they killed by hanging him on a tree.
God raised him up on the third day
and permitted him to be made manifest,
but to the witnesses preordained by God,
to those of us who ate
qui manducavimus et bibimus cum illo postquam resurrexit a mortuis.
and drank with him after he rose again from the dead.
And he instructed us to preach to the people,
and to testify that he is the One who was appointed by God to be the judge of the living
quia ipse est qui constitutus est a Deo judex vivorum et mortuorum.
Huic omnes prophetæ testimonium perhibent remissionem peccatorum accipere per nomen ejus omnes qui credunt in eum.
To him all the Prophets offer testimony that through his name all who believe in him receive the remission of sins.”
While Peter was still speaking these words,
cecidit Spiritus Sanctus super omnes qui audiebant verbum.
the Holy Spirit fell over all of those who were listening to the Word.
Et obstupuerunt ex circumcisione fideles qui venerant cum Petro,
And the faithful of the circumcision,
et in nationes gratia Spiritus Sancti effusa est.
were astonished that the grace of the Holy Spirit was also poured out upon the Gentiles.
For they heard them speaking in tongues
Numquid aquam quis prohibere potest ut non baptizentur hi qui Spiritum Sanctum acceperunt sicut et nos?
“How could anyone prohibit water, so that those who have received the Holy Spirit would not be baptized, just as we also have been?”
Et jussit eos baptizari in nomine Domini Jesu Christi.
And he ordered them to be baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ.
Tunc rogaverunt eum ut maneret apud eos aliquot diebus.
Then they begged him to remain with them for some days.
